page.overview:
Who is Larson Mitchell?

Larson Mitchell is a theme park critic who visits Jurassic World from the miniseries, LEGO Jurassic World: Legend of Isla Nublar. He appeared in the episodes, Mission: Critical! and The Power and the Peril!. He was voiced by Kirby Morrow. Given that his last name is Mitchell, it is unknown if he's related to Zach Mitchell and Gray Mitchell or not.
